title: Deploy and live-verify the reviewed TASK-307 gateway patch on Smalls
description: Workflow-safe continuation after TASK-307 was prematurely advanced to APPROVED at code-review time before its deployment/live-verification criteria ran. Operator directed continuation and Nene recorded approval to deploy once the workflow correction was ready. Deploy only the exact attempt-3 hashes approved in MAP_System/artifacts/reviews/task307-smalls-rereview3-codex-lab-vumo.md to Smalls/RUKI, with pre-write backup, staged checksum verification, recoverable activation, focused tests, live success/fail-closed probes, durable evidence, and independent final review. Preserve RUKI map.db authority, credentials, configuration, hcom state, unrelated source, and all user work. This task records rather than erases TASK-307s premature-approval discrepancy and does not fix the separate review-artifact transport problem.
acceptance_criteria: Record TASK-307s premature-approval discrepancy, the attempt-3 approved review artifact, and exact reviewed SHA-256 values before any Smalls write.

Confirm destination home@192.168.1.153 hostname MediaCenter device RUKI and preserve a timestamped backup of every target file before activation; never modify map.db directly, authority topology, credentials, hcom state, runtime state, or unrelated files.
Stage only the exact approved TASK-307 files, prove every staged hash equals the approved Biggie hash, run compile/focused tests in staging, and activate recoverably only after all checks pass.

Post-deploy verification on live RUKI proves register-agent succeeds idempotently for an existing approved agent identity, rotation-transfer fails closed for invalid/nonexistent state without mutation, rotation-restore rejects unknown or replayed transfer IDs without unrelated row drift, and the forced-command gateway rejects the obsolete three-row-JSON restore shape.

Record deployed paths, before/after hashes, backup/rollback location, commands/results, relay health, and rollback outcome if needed in the deployment artifact; a different core agent performs final functional and security-framed review before completion.
